h: Wike reportedly promises Tinubu appointment for PDP candidate who stepped down for APC
p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly pledged a federal appointment from President Tinubu to a PDP candidate who withdrew from a race in favour of the APC candidate. The reported promise is likely to draw reaction from opposition parties ahead of 2027.
more: Opposition parties are yet to respond to the reported pledge.
The details of the post on offer have not been disclosed.
